pages.text: Drain the life force from plants to fill your Blood Altar. This ritual scans for plant matter and consumes it, converting organic energy into Life Essence.

pages.title: Costs & Details
pages.text: $(bold)Activation:$() 3000 LP$(br)$(bold)Refresh:$() 10 LP$(br)$(bold)Refresh Time:$() 80 ticks (configurable), dropping to 16 as $(will)Corrosive Will$() builds up$(br2)$(bold)Effect Range:$() 8 blocks radius, expandable to 32 with the Ritual Tinkerer$(br)$(bold)Altar Range:$() Searches 32 blocks horizontally (±10 blocks vertically)$(br2)Consumes 1-3 plants per cycle, generating 50 LP (configurable) per plant consumed. Altar location is cached for performance.

pages.title: Will Generation
pages.text: $(bold)Demon Will:$() This ritual generates $(will)Corrosive Will$() as it consumes plants.$(br2)$(li)0.5-1.5 will per plant$(li)Max 100 will in the area$(br2)$(bold)Speed:$() More corrosive will = faster operation. The ritual feeds its own will supply as it eats, so it winds itself up the longer it runs.$(br2)Perfect for automated LP generation from tree farms!
